# The data center backlash comes for SpaceXAI’s Colossus
Dozens of temporary gas turbines are powering SpaceXAI’s expansion—and fights over permits and pollution

By July, Mississippi regulators counted 69 temporary gas turbines at the site—more than double the number the company had previously acknowledged.

### Sign Up for Our Daily Newsletter
In Memphis, xAI was relying on temporary gas turbines at Colossus 1 by 2024. The dozens of temporary turbines at Colossus 1 disappeared around the same time similar machines began appearing in Mississippi, according to an SELC attorney.

The temporary turbines have a negotiated exit schedule, but SpaceXAI has permission to replace them with a permanent power plant.
